0022600187.text: The Orlando Magic (2-5, 0-4 at home, 2-1 on the road, on a two-game losing streak) are 5th in the Southeast, 2 games back, and 11th in the East, and they visit the Phoenix Suns (1-4, 1-1 at home, on a three-game losing streak), who are 3rd in the Pacific, 3.5 games back, and 12th in the West. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee; 8.0 points and 33.4 minutes per game this season), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain; 24.5 points and 33.8 minutes per game this season), while Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, and their last meeting was on March 31, 2026, in Orlando, where the Magic won 115-111.
